name: nodebox-appcast
description: The update feed NodeBox checks, built from GitHub releases: a Cloudflare Worker.

scripts.deploy: export CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID=$(op read 'op://NodeBox/NodeBox App/Appcast/CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID') && wrangler deploy
scripts.secrets: export CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID=$(op read 'op://NodeBox/NodeBox App/Appcast/CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID') && op read 'op://NodeBox/NodeBox App/Appcast/GITHUB_TOKEN' | wrangler secret put GITHUB_TOKEN
